items.title: SAIC to sell additional 10% stake in JSW MG Motor India to JSW: Report
items.summary: SAIC Motor is set to sell an additional 10% stake in JSW MG Motor India to JSW Group, which would become the company’s largest shareholder, as the Chinese automaker navigates India’s investment restrictions and prepares for new vehicle launches.

items.title: Volkswagen debuts in Sri Lanka with India-built Taigun and Virtus
items.summary: Škoda Auto Volkswagen India has launched the brand in Sri Lanka through Continental Cars, expanding its export-led regional footprint from the Pune manufacturing hub.

items.title: Stellantis plays down European scope for JLR and Tata partnerships
items.summary: Stellantis will not expand its new partnerships with Jaguar Land Rover and Tata Motors into Europe. The company's Europe chief, Emanuele Cappellano, confirmed these collaborations are focused on the US and India. A niche Jeep model made in China with Dongfeng may also be sold in Europe.

items.title: Toyota prices top-spec Urban Cruiser Ebella E3 at ₹23.6 lakh
items.summary: The top of the line E3 variant comes with a 61 kWh battery, seven airbags, panoramic roof and digital cockpit, while prices of other variants remain under wraps.

items.title: Tata Motors PV eyes reigniting India’s hatchback market with new Tiago
items.summary: The automaker believes that feature-rich upgrades and multiple powertrain options can help hatchbacks regain appeal among first-time car buyers amid the growing dominance of SUVs.

items.summary: He also expressed optimism about the electric vehicle transition, while cautioning that charging infrastructure remained a major bottleneck, particularly outside metros. EV adoption in the two-wheeler segment is progressing faster because home charging is easier to manage.

items.title: Bosch’s India Recast
items.summary: On May 21, 2026, the German engineering giant Bosch Ltd announced a 50:50 joint venture with the TSF Group’s Brakes India and Wheels India. While the deal might appear to be a localized expansion of air systems for commercial vehicles (CVs), it serves as a microcosm for a much larger, more aggressive transformation as the automotive industry in India is set to evolve rapidly by 2030 and beyond.

items.title: Atul Auto, Exponent Energy partner to roll out 15-minute charging electric three-wheelers
items.summary: The tie-up will integrate 15-minute rapid charging technology into factory-built vehicles, aiming to accelerate EV adoption in the commercial segment.

items.title: Tesla repositions Model Y in India to take on BMW, Mercedes EVs
items.summary: Tesla has aggressively cut prices on its Model Y in India, aiming to compete with luxury rivals despite import duties. This strategic move follows a slow market entry, with rising fuel costs now potentially boosting EV adoption. The new Model Y Premium RWD is priced significantly lower, broadening Tesla's appeal to a wider range of premium car buyers.

items.title: Tata AutoComp forms JV with Korea’s Jahwa Electronics for EV heater systems
items.summary: T​he joint venture will position India as a strategic manufacturing and supply hub for Jahwa Electronics, leveraging growing demand for electrified mobility solutions in the country.

items.title: Tata AutoComp Partners With Jahwa Electronics for EV Component Manufacturing
items.summary: Tata AutoComp Systems Limited has entered into a joint venture agreement with South Korea based Jahwa Electronics to locally manufacture and supply advanced thermal management solutions for the Indian automotive market. items.title: Tata Motors PV launches next-gen Tiago range from ₹4.69 lakh with EV, CNG options
items.summary: The new range gets connected features, dual-screen cabin, ADAS-linked safety tech and multiple powertrain options as Tata Motors PV looks to revive hatchback demand amid India’s SUV shift.

items.title: EV sales in fast lane but motown treads the middle path
items.summary: Carmakers are simultaneously investing in EV architectures, hybrid systems, alternative fuels, and cleaner combustion technologies. Suppliers too are getting impacted, having to spread resources across multiple technology platforms.

items.title: Amara Raja plans ₹1,700 crore capex push for FY27; targets Q1 FY28 lithium plant launch
items.summary: The lead acid battery manufacturer through its new energy business unit, Amara Raja Advanced Technologies, is targeting a total cell manufacturing capacity of 16GWh in a phased manner by 2030.

items.title: TVS Srichakra Approves Rs 220 Crore Capex for Capacity Expansion at Madurai Plants
items.summary: The board of directors of TVS Srichakra Limited has approved a capital investment of up to Rs 220 crore to expand production capacities at its manufacturing facilities located in Vellaripatti, Madurai. The decision was finalized during a board meeting on May 27, 2026, according to a regulatory filing submitted to the stock exchanges.

items.title: JK Tyre Unveils One Of Its Largest Capex Plans As Capacity Utilisation Crosses 90%
items.summary: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd has announced one of its largest-ever capital expenditure plans, approving a Rs 4,980 crore phased expansion of its truck and passenger car radial tyre capacities amid strong demand across domestic and export markets. The expansion, approved by the company’s board, will increase overall capacity by 24% over the next three years and will primarily focus on the Chennai and Mysore plants.
